title: LocalHarnessOptions
description: Options for createLocalHarness(). Discriminated union on model.kind: 'scripted' (testing) or 'openai-compatible' (live provider).

repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the workspace root. Used by WorkspaceGuard and buildRepoProfile.

stateDirectory.description: Directory for FileFactStore and FileMemoryStore. Created if missing.

modelPackPath.description: Override path to a Model Pack JSON. Defaults to the bundled generic-openai pack.

approvalMode.description: Harness-level approval mode. 'deny' (default) rejects all writes; 'prompt' delegates to approval port; 'auto-safe' auto-grants registered commands and safe writes.

approval.description: TypeScript injection point: ApprovalPort { request(request: ApprovalRequest): Promise<boolean> }. Not JSON-serializable; pass programmatically.

trustRepoConfig.description: Trust .focuscode/config.json verification commands. Defaults to false.

workerId.description: Worker identifier for fact store concurrency. Defaults to `local-worker:${process.pid}`.

factStore.description: TypeScript injection point: FactPort. Override the default FileFactStore (e.g., with a Postgres-backed implementation). Not JSON-serializable.

verifier.description: TypeScript injection point: VerifyPort. Override the default RegisteredCommandVerifier. Not JSON-serializable.

decision.description: TypeScript injection point: DecisionPort. Override the model.kind switch (e.g., with a circuit-breaker wrapper). Not JSON-serializable.

steps.description: ScriptedStep[] from @focuscode/testkit. Replays deterministic model decisions for tests.

apiKey.description: Optional API key. Prefer environment variable over config.

extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers for the OpenAI-compatible transport.
